payload.comment: Profiling stage is consistent and complete. All deterministic checks pass (deterministic_findings is empty). Key verifications: (1) Split sizes (train 89996, val 10004, test 7180) match the official MedMNIST PathMNIST distribution exactly; subsampled=false confirms no truncation. (2) n_channels=3, n_classes=9, image_shape_hwc=[28,28,3] are correct for the standard 28×28 RGB MedMNIST PathMNIST task. (3) Class distribution is well-balanced with a modest imbalance ratio of 1.63; train and val class proportions agree to within <0.001 absolute difference, indicating no split-level distribution shift. (4) No blank images (fraction 0.0) and no duplicate train samples. (5) Channel statistics (means ≈0.53–0.74, stds ≈0.12–0.18 in [0,1] range) are consistent with H&E-stained histology patches. (6) Provenance is well-documented: archive_md5, per-split selected_index_sha256, code_sha256, and full package_versions are present. (7) Ambiguity risks (e.g., background/debris/mucus overlap, adipose vs. background, smooth muscle vs. stroma) are appropriately flagged as expected challenges at 28×28 resolution and do not constitute data-integrity defects. Minor non-blocking notes: llm_model_digest is null (qwen3.8 checkpoint not pinned), which weakens reproducibility for any LLM-assisted downstream steps; test-set class distribution was not profiled (samples_profiled=100000 = train+val only), which is a reasonable design choice to avoid test-set leakage but means test_imbalance_ratio=1.0 and test_to_train_prevalence_ratio=[] are placeholders rather than computed values. Neither note blocks progression. No deterministic findings require action. Proceed to the next stage.
llm_issues: llm_model_digest is null; the exact qwen3.8 model checkpoint is not pinned, weakening reproducibility for LLM-assisted downstream steps (non-blocking).

Test-set class distribution was not profiled (samples_profiled=100000 covers train+val only); test_imbalance_ratio=1.0 and test_to_train_prevalence_ratio=[] are placeholders, not computed values. This is a reasonable anti-leakage design choice but limits cross-split distribution verification.
